##### CATHOLIC CHURCH STATISTICS 2022

Special feature prepared by Stefano Lodigiani

Vatican City (Agenzia Fides) – As every year, in view of World Mission Sunday, which this year 
celebrates its 96th anniversary on Sunday, October 23, 2022, Fides New Service offers some statistics 
chosen to give a panorama of the missionary Church all over the world. 
The tables are taken from the latest edition of the «Church’s Book of Statistics» published (updated 
to December 31, 2020) regarding members of the Church, church structures, healthcare, welfare and 
education. Please note that variations are indicated in brackets, increase (+) or decrease (-) compared 
to the previous year (2019), according to the comparison made by Fides News Service. 
Finally, the picture of ecclesiastical circumscriptions dependent on the Dicastery for Evangelization 
is reported. 
World Population 
To December 31, 2020 the world population was 7.667.136.000, with an increase of 
89.359.000 units compared to the previous year. Population growth was registered, even this year, on 
every continent. Increases were registered above all in Asia (+39.670.000) and in Africa 
(+37.844.000), followed by America (+8.560.000), Europe (+2.657.000) and Oceania (+628.000). 
Catholics 
On the same date, December 31, 2020, Catholics in the world numbered 1.359.612.000 units 
with an overall increase of 15.209.000 units compared to the previous year. The increase affects all 
continents, except Oceania (-9.000). As in the past, increases were registered above all in Africa 
(+5.290.000) and in America (+6.463.000), followed by Asia (+2.731.000) and Europe (+734.000). 
The world percentage of Catholics decreased slightly (-0,01) compared to the previous year 
reaching 17,73%. The continents register slight variations, except Oceania which remains unvvaried. 

Persons and Catholics per priest This year the number of persons per priest in the world increased by 95 units, average 14.948. There are increases in Oceania (+349), America (+177) and Europe (+130). A decrease in Africa (-1.784) and Asia (-78). The number of Catholics per priest in the world increased by 69 units, average 3.314. There are increases in all continents: America (+117), Oceania (+53), Europe (+49), Asia (+15) and Africa (+3).

Ecclesiastical circumscriptions and mission stations The number of ecclesiastical circumscriptions increased by only 1 unit compared to the previous year, to 3.027. New circumscriptions were created only in America (+2), while the number in all other continents remains unvaried, except in Asia, where there was a decrease of 1 unit. Mission Stations with a resident priest number 3.284 (+67). Increases were registered in America (+149) and in Oceania (+6), decrease in Asia (-66), in Africa (-19) and in Europe (-3).

Mission Stations without a resident priest decreased by 253 units, reaching a total 131.154 with variations in all continents: decrease in America (-122), in Asia (-383), in Europe (-1), increase in Africa (+249) and in Oceania (+4).

Bishops The total number of priests in the world decreased by 1 unit, to 5.363. Diocesan Bishops increased (+22) and Religious Bishops decreased (-23). Diocesan Bishops number 4.156, while Religious Bishops number 1.207. Diocesan Bishops increase in America (+25) and in Asia (+2), while a decrease was registered in Europe (-4) and in Oceania (-1), unvaried in Africa. Religious Bishops decrease in all continents: America (-9), Asia (-7), Europe (-5), Africa (-2). Unvaried in Oceania.

Priests The total number of priests in the world decreased to 410.219 (-4.117). The continent which registered a major decrease was again Europe (-4.374) as well as America (-1.421) and Oceania (-104). Increases were registered in Africa (+1.004) and in Asia (+778). Diocesan priests in the world decreased by 1.615 units, reaching a total of 280.521, with a decrease in Europe (-2.880), in America (-364) and in Oceania (-40). Increases were registered in Africa (+1.116) and in Asia (+553). The number of Religious priests decreased by 2.502 units, to a total 129.698. Increases were registered only in Asia (+225), decreases in Europe (-1.494), America (-1.057) Africa (-112), and Oceania (-64).

Permanent Deacons Permanent deacons in the world continue to increase, this year reaching 397 units, to 48.635. The highest increase was registered in America (+558) and in Oceania (+38), a decrease in Europe (-97), Asia (-62) and Africa (-40). Permanent diocesan deacons in the world are 48.259, with an overall increase of 656 units. Increase in America (+604), Oceania (+36), Asia (+17), Europe (+10), decrease only in Africa (-11). Religious permanent deacons number 376, with a decrease of 259 units compared to the previous year. Decreases in Europe (-107), Asia (-79), America (-46), Africa (-29), the only increase in Oceania (+2).

Men and women religious The number of non-religious priests increased by 274 units, to 50.569. Decreases were registered in America (-537) and in Oceania (-67). Increases in Europe (+428), Asia (+347) and in Africa (+103). Even this year there is an overall decrease in the number of women religious by 10.553 units, to a total 619.546. Increases were registered, once again, in Africa (+2.503) and in Asia (+364), decrease in Europe (-8.852), America (-4.326) and Oceania (–242).

Members of secular institutes, male and female Members of male institutes number 583 (+1). A decrease only in Africa (-14), increases in America (+11) and in Asia (+4), unvaried in Europe and in Oceania. Members of female institutes also decreased this year, by 947 units, to a total of 19.966 members. Increase in Africa (+60), while a decrease was registered in Europe (-924), in America (-81) and in Asia (-2), unvaried in Oceania.

Lay missionaries and Catechists

The number of lay missionaries in the world is 413.561, with an overall increase of 3.121 units. The numbers registered are: Africa (+559), America (+3.535), Asia (+4.114), Europe (-5.064), Oceania (-23). Catechists in the world decreased by 190.985 units, to a total 2.883.049. Decreases were registered in America (-162.010), in Europe (-24.954), in Asia (-18.282) and in Oceania (-505). The only increase was registered in Africa (+14.766).

Major seminarians The number of major seminarians, diocesan and religious decreased this year, they are globally 2.203 units, reaching a total 111.855. Increases were registered only in Africa (+907), decreases in America (-1.261), Asia (-1.168), Europe (-680) and Oceania (-1). Major diocesan seminarians number 67.987 (-622), and Religious major seminarians number 43.868 (-1.581). Major diocesan seminarians increased in Africa (+505) and Oceania (+9), while decreases were registered in America (-524), Europe (-497) and Asia (-115). Religious major seminarians increase only in Africa (+402), while decrease in Asia (-1.053), America (-737), Europe (-183) and Oceania (-10).

Minor seminarians The total number of minor seminarians, diocesan and religious this year decrease for the fifth consecutive year by 1.592 units to 95.398. Decreases were registered in America (-1.049), Asia (-644), Europe (-275), while increases were registered in Africa (+375) and in Oceania (+1). Minor diocesan seminarians number 73.243 (-1.733) and religious seminarians number 22.155 (+141). The number of diocesan minor seminarians decreased as follows: Africa (-353), America (-803), Asia (-448), Europe (-122) and Oceania (-7). Religious minor seminarians decreased in America (-246), Asia (-196) and in Europe (-153), while increases were registered in Africa (+728) and in Oceania (+8).

Catholic schools and education In the field of education, the Catholic Church runs 72.785 kindergartens with 7.510.632 pupils; 99.668 primary schools with 34.614.488 pupils; 49.437 secondary schools with 19.252.704 pupils. The Church also cares 2.403.787 high school pupils and 3.771.946 university students.

Catholic charity and healthcare centres Charity and healthcare centres run in the world by the Church include: 5.322 hospitals, 14.415 dispensaries, mainly in Africa (4.956) and in America (3.785); 534 Care Homes for people with Leprosy, mainly in Asia (265) and Africa (210); 15.204 Homes for the elderly or the chronically ill or people with a disability, mainly in Europe (7.953); 9.230 orphanages, mainly in Asia (3.201); 10.441 creches, mainly in Asia (2.801) and in America (2.816); 10.362 marriage counselling centres, mainly in Europe (5.279) and America (2.604); 3.137 social rehabilitation centres and 34.291 other kinds of institutes.

Ecclesiastical Circumscriptions dependent on the Dicastery for Evangelization The Ecclesiastical Circumscriptions dependent on the Dicastery for Evangelization are 1.118. Most of the ecclesiastical circumscriptions entrusted to the Dicastery are in Africa (518) and in Asia (483), followed by America (71) and Oceania (46).
